_comment: Clara — a room-baked android. Unlike Ada/Eva (green-screen clips composited over a room still), Clara's clips are full-frame: she's filmed IN each room, so the room is baked into the shot. composite:false makes her clip the whole view. Emotion clips (no room suffix) are BRIDGE; informative_<room> is her default in that room; more room clips to come.

capabilities._composite_note: false = full-frame room-baked clips (her clip IS the room view). No chroma key.
capabilities._audio_note: Muted for now (baked voice lines would replay). Conversation is text over comm.
capabilities._emotions_note: BRIDGE conversational emotions only (neutral implicit -> idle). In other rooms she shows informative_<room> regardless of mood until room-specific clips exist. Intimate/pose/room clips are NOT free emotion picks.
capabilities._aliases_note: Built from tools/emotion_profiler.py (300 samples). Maps the model's slip words to a real clip so they never fall to neutral. alert->brave (all from combat prompts), concerned->nervous, comforting->friendly are judgment calls — tweak freely.
capabilities._reactions_note: Hybrid reaction map: player-interaction -> her plausible reactions (her clip vocabulary). The model leads; if it returns neutral or something off this list for the interaction, the game snaps to one of these. This is where her personality lives.
capabilities._dominant_note: interaction -> her signature reaction that dominates (~75%), overriding even a valid model pick. Use for reaction clips that should reliably play.
